name: greeting
prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset: 16-frame transparent 4 by 4 animation sheet for a small desktop character. Edit image 1, the repeated ORIGINAL Yun Jin chibi, to animate her. Image 2 is the sole authoritative drawing, palette and model reference. Image 3 shows the tiny original shoes. Preserve that exact narrow, delicate, muted hand-painted 2D style, not glossy modern chibi and not thick outlines. Exact dark dusty gray-purple hair and dress, dusty muted pink panels and hat ball, soft light blue-turquoise cords, pale warm face, small muted wine-red gradient eyes with restrained highlights. No increased saturation, no pink/red darkening, no recoloring from lighting. Her two slender light turquoise cords are distinct from the long purple hair, with small cyan tassels. Small thin delicate original boots and rounded compact toes: both boots together only 21% of standing character height, each toe about 9%; do not enlarge feet. Keep original narrow skirt (~59% of standing height), hat width (~41%), overall neutral width (~61%), slender calves and same head to body ratio. No oversized head, broad skirt, big shoes, square toes, puffy sleeves, excessive hair gloss, black bold outlines, airbrush glow, white outline, extra accessories, words or symbols. Do not simplify costume or change motifs. Exactly 16 complete, clearly separated full-body poses, chronological row-major 4x4 on true transparent background. Consistent camera scale and ground line, with ample blank gutters. No touching neighboring frames, clipping or repeated extraneous body parts. Both tiny feet stay planted and maintain original shape across all 16 frames. Head, hands, sleeves, skirt, hair and thin separate cords move naturally with slow ease-in/ease-out. Preserve model through every pose. Frames 1 and 16 return to the original resting stance. Image 4 is ONLY a choreography reference for the bow, NOT a color or style reference; redraw it in the softer, less shiny, lower contrast exact style of image 2. She politely bows from her waist with hands gently brought together at chest height, dips her head, closes eyes, holds the bow briefly, then rises smoothly to the same neutral stance. Frames 1-3 preparation, 4-7 gradual descent, 8-9 held deep graceful bow, 10-14 smooth gradual rise, 15-16 settle. Allow skirt, hair and cyan cords to follow the bow with gentle secondary movement. Do NOT reproduce the saturated reds, dark cyan, large shiny eyes or sharp highlights of image 4.
rejection: Drawing proportions changed; not included in the animation pack.
